name: octoplan-codex
description: Plan Octopad work streams, then let Codex execute approved plans through model-routed independent sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Plan in Octopad, execute with routed Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Turns an Octopad work stream into a verified task plan. Execution starts only after explicit approval; Codex then follows the saved order and creates each task session with its planned model and reasoning effort.
defaultPrompt: Use $octoplan to plan this Octopad work stream.
